params.topic: Finland Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 club, venue and related pre-match metadata gap supplement
questions: Resolve the 21 checklist rows below using official club, federation, league, venue, municipal, or dated historical schedule sources. Return row-level facts only; preserve NULL when unresolved and keep conflicts instead of choosing a winner.

For club identity and founded/entry fields, distinguish the legal/current club from predecessor clubs, mergers, renamed entities, and same-name clubs. FC Lahti must explicitly test whether an entry year earlier than 1996 belongs to a predecessor or a different entity. FinnPa must be checked as the Helsinki club, not a Danish venue mapping. TP-Seinäjoki founded year needs an official or federation confirmation, not only a secondary source.

For venues, return canonical venue name, former names/aliases, city or district, WGS84 latitude/longitude, source URL, and the season/date validity interval. Do not substitute a city centre for a missing stadium. OTP must be season/date keyed for Raatti versus later Heinäpää usage. Ponnistus must test Haapaniemi against the suspicious Tapiola mapping. Conflicting venues remain separate evidence rows.

For home_standing and away_standing, only return a dated pre-kickoff standings snapshot when the source explicitly dates it before the fixture; do not reconstruct standings from final tables or infer from match order.

For official_round and meeting_number rows included in this broad 21-row manifest, report only source candidates and explicit semantics if encountered; do not derive either field from date, CSV order, or fixture index. The focused official schedule request is the authoritative task for these two fields.

Use multilingual aliases and historical spellings: FinnPa/FinnPA, KuPS/Kuopion Palloseura, FC Lahti/Lahti, OTP/Oulun Työväen Palloilijat, Ekenäs IF/EIF/Tammisaari, FC Hämeenlinna, FC Jazz/Pori, Kumu/Kuusankoski, MP/Mikkelin Palloilijat, Ponnistus/Haapaniemi, TPV/Tampereen Pallo-Veikot, Tampere United, TP-Seinäjoki/Törnävän Pallo-55/TP-55.

For each target return stable_key, field_name, value or NULL, status, source_name, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256, validity_start, validity_end, and conflict_group_id when applicable.

Return audit counts expected/discovered/complete/partial/missing and an unresolved_queue. A missing or blocked field must remain in the output with a reason. Do not return Qimen, model, probability, odds, Outcome, Review, Gold, or any formal prediction field. Do not write or request credentials.
